name: Checkpoint: daily sales report
description: Exercises the timeout step. Only emails whose subject contains 'Daily Sales Report' reach the timeout step, which touches the 'daily-sales-report' checkpoint (created on first touch, 1h normal / 1h late interval). Note that the step stamps last_seen_at with processing time, not the email's Date header. Use with example-data/emails/checkpoint_daily_report_pass.eml (subject matches, checkpoint touched; check_checkpoints.py marks it 'ok' once next_expected_at passes) or checkpoint_daily_report_fail.eml (subject doesn't match, the timeout step never runs; process only this one and check_checkpoints.py marks the existing checkpoint 'missed' at the next deadline). Process the pass email first so the checkpoint exists.
